title: 각주 및 미주 변환
description: Type > Convert Footnotes and Endnotes: every footnote of the document to an endnote, or every endnote to a footnote. Convert applies and the dialog stays open with the same direction (as InDesign's); Done closes it. Only the whole document is converted (the selection scope is not supported).
